category_edits.rationale: Replace the feed-forward ReLU with GELU to test whether smoother nonlinear transformations improve preference modeling. Preserve all other architecture and training settings. The generated predictor imports SASRec from train.py, so it automatically uses the updated activation.

change_summary: Use GELU in every SASRec feed-forward block for all four category models; retain existing checkpoint compatibility and predictor routing.
